text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — telemetry gaps detected for ~24 onboarding tenants between 03:10–03:30 UTC. Many of these are on renewal pilots. Working on a customer note draft now. :warning:

sam_ops_bot: [ALERT] Ingest-service-eu-west reported 503s — restarting replica group at 03:12 UTC.

oliver_se: Thanks Maria. Do we know if embeddings/ingest or routing is impacted? Any p50/p95 hits?

jasdeep_eng: Root scope: telemetry pipeline (kafka->ingest) lost a subset of partition assignments during a config push. Affected messages were backfilled but not tagged to tenants, so some onboarding telemetry didn't make it to account health dashboards. p95 token latency briefly spiked but gen endpoints unaffected.

maria_cs: Ugh. Renewal-sensitive customers listed in sheet: https://redwood.work/ops/onboard-telemetry-impacted (private). Drafting customer-facing note — want to include apology, brief RCA, mitigation, and next steps.

diane_pm: Draft suggestion (short):
"Hi — we experienced a transient telemetry ingestion gap on DATE that impacted onboarding progress indicators. The root cause was an internal config rollout that temporarily disrupted partition assignment. We have backfilled data where possible and are offering a 7-day onboarding concierge + one month credit for affected trial accounts. Next steps: we will host office hours and send a final RCA within 48 hours."

kevin_se: Suggest add: contact point + link to enablement calendar, and call out what customers might see (delayed progress bars, missing sample counts). Keep it concise.

maria_cs: OK I'm going to post this to the 24 affected tenants with small personalization. Who can approve send copy? Diane + Jasdeep for tech + mitigation ack.

jasdeep_eng: Ack — RCA language good. Add: "no model outputs or data was exposed; only internal telemetry was affected."

oliver_se: Ops mitigation: we rolled back the config change, forced partition rebalance, and reprocessed the 03:10–03:30 window with tenant tagging. Full backfill job ran at 03:45 and succeeded for 22/24 tenants; 2 tenants required manual re-ingest (tracking in sheet).

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll send first outbound now to high-touch renewals (DM + email). Template below — please quick-check: 

```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know about a short telemetry ingestion gap on <DATE> that may have caused temporary delays in your onboarding progress indicators. We have: 
- Identified the root cause (internal config rollout) and rolled it back; 
- Backfilled most missing telemetry; two tenants need manual re-ingest (we're on it); 
- Confirmed no customer data or model outputs were exposed.

We value your time — if this impacted your trial or renewal review, we are offering a 1-month credit and a 7-day onboarding concierge session. Please reply here or book: https://redwood.work/enablement.

Apologies for the interruption — full RCA coming within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success
```

maria_cs: Sending in 5 unless objections.

kevin_se: :thumbsup: from infra side.

diane_pm: Approved. Maybe call out office hours times: 14:00 & 18:00 UTC today.

maria_cs: Updated and sent to high-touch list. I'll copy links and follow-up notes here after sending.

sam_ops_bot: [DEPLOY] Config rollback completed at 03:22 UTC by jasdeep_eng. Backfill job status: 22/24 success, 2 pending_manual_reingest.

maria_cs: Follow-up — sent to high-touch list at 08:11 UTC. Logged customers + notes in the sheet. Planning an automated email to broader affected cohort at 09:00 UTC.

jasdeep_eng: We'll prioritize manual re-ingest for the two tenants (ETA 6 hrs). Also adding a stricter preflight for config rollouts to prevent partition drift.

oliver_se: I'll put a monitoring alert for partition assignment imbalance and a runbook link (https://redwood.runbooks/partition-drift).

maria_cs: Thanks all. After office hours and final RCA we'll capture customer feedback and decide on extra credit eligibility. Closing loop here once manual re-ingest done.

kevin_se: FYI I've pinged renewals ops to flag the two tenants as "re-review after reingest".

maria_cs: Thread closed for now — will update last_message_ts when RCA posted. :pray:
